# Block Theme Development Agents

This folder contains all agents related to WordPress Block Theme development, Full Site Editing (FSE),
theme.json configuration, and modern theme architecture.

## Agents in This Folder (14 agents)

| Agent | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| [block-theme-developer](block-theme-developer.agent.md) | Primary FSE and block theme development |
| [block-theme-optimizer](block-theme-optimizer.agent.md) | Theme performance and optimization |
| [theme-architect](theme-architect.agent.md) | General theme architecture guidance |
| [wordpress-block-theme-architect](wordpress-block-theme-architect.agent.md) | Block theme architecture specialist |
| [wp-theme-architect](wp-theme-architect.agent.md) | WordPress theme patterns and conventions |

| [wp-accessibility-review](wp-accessibility-review.agent.md) | Accessibility auditing and testing |
| [wp-performance-audit](wp-performance-audit.agent.md) | Performance auditing and optimization |
| [wp-security-review](wp-security-review.agent.md) | Security review and hardening |

## Primary Agent

### Block Theme Developer

**Use for:** Day-to-day block theme development tasks

- Theme.json configuration and design systems
- Template hierarchy and custom templates
- Block patterns and style variations
- Performance and accessibility optimization

## Common Workflows

### Creating a New Block Theme

1. Start with **wordpress-block-theme-architect** for architecture planning
2. Use **block-theme-developer** for implementation
3. Review with **wp-accessibility-review**
4. Optimize with **block-theme-optimizer**

### Converting Classic to Block Theme

1. Consult **theme-architect** for migration strategy
2. Implement with **block-theme-developer**
3. Validate with **wordpress-block-theme-architect**

### Theme Auditing

1. Security: **wp-security-review**
2. Performance: **wp-performance-audit**
3. Accessibility: **wp-accessibility-review**
